name: syncity

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && electron-vite build

//dependencies: Runtime-only, and deliberately short: electron-builder copies EVERY production dependency into the shipped app, while electron-vite bundles the renderer outright and externalizes only these for main/preload. A renderer-only package listed here ships twice — once inside the bundle, once as a node_modules copy nothing loads. Anything imported solely from src/renderer belongs in devDependencies.
description: Lyrics and now-playing overlay for Spotify.
author: Jackson Tran
